result.title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
result.summary: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/forever208/EiT

AI.brief_summary: 论文从架构、表示和频域三方面考察像素空间扩散的设计因素，提出带通道维度瓶颈的 U 形像素扩散 Transformer（EiT），并分析逐层、逐时间步的表示动态，在 ImageNet 与视频生成上超过对照方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「去噪/局部特征扩张—基底抬升—后验投影」的跨层跨步表示动态与通道瓶颈压缩分析，可能为刻画 LVR 中 latent 状态的分阶段演化与信息压缩程度提供可核查的观察视角，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理。
